newsitem.title: USA: Genl Dynamics says will seek acquisitions.
newsitem.headline: Genl Dynamics says will seek acquisitions.

text.p: General Dynamics Corp on Wednesday said that its "exceptional" cash position will enable it to seek aquisitions in the defense industry.

"All of our programs are strong and healthy, we're generating free cash flow of more than $200 million per year, and our backlog of business is growing," Chairman and CEO James R. Mellor said in a statement.

"With more than a billion dollars in cash and virtually no debt, we clearly have the capacity to take advantage of attractive acquisition opportunities in the ongoing consolidation of the defense industry," he said.

Earlier, the company reported 1996 third quarter earnings from continuing operations of $68 million, or $1.08 per share, up from the third quarter of 1995, when earnings from continuing operations were $62 million, or 99 cents per share.
Third quarter 1996 sales were $862 million, compared with $718 million in the same period last year.
